replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your claim is not supported and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stands. To the driver: the fee is confirmed as chargeable and you are owed 80% of it, SGD 3.20.

THE WAITING PERIOD. Your case, and the rider advocate's lead point, is that the car 'never stayed five minutes in one place'. On the platform's own telemetry the driver was inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup in two spells — 18:44:45 to 18:47:35 (170 s) and 18:49:35 to 18:52:40 (185 s). Taken alone, neither reaches the 300 s minimum, and the longest single hold is 185 s. But POL-NS-06(i) expressly permits separate in-geofence intervals within a single pickup attempt to be summed, where the driver never travelled more than 300 m from the pin AND a traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION covers the pickup road over the wait. Both conditions are met on this record: the driver's furthest point during the loop was 179.0 m, inside the 300 m leash, and LTA advisory ADV-20260807-014 records a full-day bus lane in force 17:00-20:00 on Orchard Road and Orchard Turn between Paterson Rd and Bideford Rd, its geometry covering the pickup point and its window covering the whole wait. The effective dwell is therefore 170 + 185 = 355 s against the 300 s LARGE_VENUE minimum — a surplus of 55 s — so POL-NS-06's full-refund route does not fire. The rider advocate's submission that limb (i) 'only permits summing' and does not make the 120 s away from the bay into waiting time is rejected: converting lawful absence at a no-stopping kerb into counting time is precisely what limb (i) does, and the 300 m leash is the guard the policy chose.

THE EARLY ARRIVAL MARKER. The rider advocate's remaining limb-(b) point is that the 'arrived' event at 18:44:30 precedes the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:44:45 by 15 seconds. That does not defeat the fee. POL-NS-05 catches a marker only where the trace puts the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or shows him at 15 km/h or above, at the marker moment; neither is shown (the greatest distance recorded anywhere in the attempt was 179 m, and the 15 s is far inside the 90 s clock-skew threshold in POL-NS-08(a), so no integrity defect arises). POL-NS-05 itself provides that a marker that is merely early is not a technicality that voids an otherwise good fee: the waiting clock simply runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and on that recomputed basis the effective dwell still clears the minimum. The driver advocate's limb (iii) argument is accepted on this point; the rider advocate's contrary reading is rejected.

TIMING OF CANCELLATION. The rider advocate's second point — that a continuous 300 s from the final hold at 18:49:35 would not elapse until 18:54:35, so the 18:52:45 cancellation was 110 s early — measures from the wrong start and ignores accumulation. The dwell runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:44:45 and accumulates to 355 s by 18:50:40, before the driver terminated at 18:52:45. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) hold: the trip record carries the arrived event, no boarding event and no started_at, and the termination reason code is RIDER_NO_SHOW.

POL-NS-04. This clause does not exonerate the rider. The driver answered the rider's 18:46:20 message ('ok coming down now') at 18:47:50 — 90 seconds later, inside the 120 s limit — so limb (b) is not met. Limb (c) fails affirmatively as well: the rider_track holds 70 fixes, all at 0.0 km/h, lying between 690.7 m and 717.2 m from the pin, none within the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius. The driver advocate's point that the rider's own device contradicts her narrative of 'watching the app' and 'coming down' is accepted as corroboration of the no-show.

FARE AND COMPENSATION. The SGD 4.00 charge reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule — the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (4.00) — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect and no route to even a partial refund. POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 applies: the driver is compensated at 80% of the fee, SGD 3.20, the residual 20% being the platform service fee. The anti-farming guard does not bite — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 118 is 0.017, below 0.08 — so compensation is paid and no escalation arises. Per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd mirrors the driver payment on the same figure.

POL-NS-03. There is no wrong-entrance or wrong-block case: the driver's holds were inside the arrival radius, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill branch is unavailable. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is met, and no clause produces a referral.
